 News › News News › School Holiday Tomorrow, october 23, 2026? Check state-wise holiday updates School Holiday Tomorrow, october 23, 2026? Check state-wise holiday updates
 Sajid Raza Published: Oct 22, 2026, 17:15 IST Updated: Oct 22, 2026, 17:15 IST School holiday tomorrow? As Dussehra and Durga Puja holiday is ending Friday, October 23, in several states in the country, each school will have a different time table. Some students may be able to extend their festive break, while others are likely to be back in class.
 A national order if there is one is not yet available for October 23. Please refer to the most up-to-date holiday notice from your school before assuming classes will be cancelled.
 In most parts of India, the occasion of Vijayadashami or Dussehra was celebrated on 20 October 2026. However, the dates for school reopening will be based on the academic calendar, state education department guidelines and local holiday announcements.
 School holiday on october 23: State-wise update
 The following table highlights the reported Dussehra and autumn vacation schedules in selected states and regions.
 State/Region Reported Holiday Schedule Expected Status on October 23 
 Uttar Pradesh October 18–25 (reported extended break) Schools following this break may remain closed 
 Delhi-NCR October 18–20 in several calendars Generally expected to reopen 
 Bihar October 17–21 Expected to be open 
 Jharkhand October 19–21 Expected to be open 
 Andhra Pradesh October 12–21 Expected to be open 
 Telangana October 10–22 Expected to reopen 
 West Bengal October 15–26 Schools following Puja break may remain closed 
 Karnataka Around October 10–21 in several schedules Expected to be open 
 Kerala Depends on the school calendar Check local schedule 
 Uttar Pradesh and Noida school holiday update
 Students in Uttar Pradesh, including Noida, may be wondering whether schools will remain closed on October 23.
 According to some school holiday schedules, there will be an extended autumn break until October 25, after which schools will resume on October 26. Friday may be a school day if the school is operating under this schedule.
 But other school calendars offer just a brief break during the Dussehra festival on October 19 and 20. Thus, the holiday dates might vary from institution to institution.
 Parents in Noida and Ghaziabad should refer to the official circular or message of their school for the confirmed date of the school reopening.
 Delhi school holiday update
 There are several reported school calendars in Delhi that give them a break for Dussehra from 18th October to 20th October. 
 The schedule indicates that schools should open before October 23 and this is typically the case.
 However, the dates for the autumn vacations and local holiday arrangements may vary from school to school. Students need to check the most recent notification from the respective institutions.
 Telangana school holiday update
 The schools in Telangana are to resume classes after Dasara vacation on 23rd October.
 A report from the Telangana School Education department states that Dasara holidays have been announced for all schools in the state, from October 10 to October 22, with a proposal to resume the classes on October 23.
 Students should check with their schools regarding the reopening schedule and any examination-related instructions.
 West Bengal school holiday update
 Schools in West Bengal may continue their Durga Puja and autumn vacation through October 26.
 Under the reported holiday schedule, schools following the extended break are expected to reopen on October 27. The dates may vary depending on the school management and academic calendar.
 November 2026 school holiday list
 Students can also look forward to several festivals and observances in November 2026. However, not every occasion will result in a school holiday in every state.
 Date Day Festival/Occasion 
 November 1 Sunday Regional observances, including Kannada Rajyotsava 
 November 8 Sunday Diwali / Deepavali 
 November 9 Monday Govardhan Puja in calendars observing it on this date 
 November 11 Wednesday Bhai Dooj in several festival calendars 
 November 15 Sunday Chhath Puja 
 November 24 Tuesday Guru Nanak Jayanti / Kartik Purnima 
 November 27 Friday Kanakadasa Jayanti (regional observance) 
 The actual school holiday dates may vary according to state notifications and institutional calendars. Students should check the applicable November holiday list for confirmed closures.
